meddra.observation: Terminology downloads require MedDRA ID/password and a release-specific unzip password. Subscription includes English and available translations. Public v28.1 documentation reports 27 deployed languages; the official temporary site exposes v29.0 support documentation but terminology release files remain authenticated.

mlds.observation: MLDS manages affiliate licensing and approved release packages. Each package requires licence acceptance; member/national centres may impose additional conditions and non-member use requires annual reporting.

reuse.rule: reference an exact existing hash/path instead of uploading duplicate bytes

execution.credentials: GitHub encrypted secrets only; never manifests, logs, artifacts or repository files
